# A package of a FIPS snapshot has a root, its module's directory, so go test
# caches its result like any other package's.

env snap=v1.26.0
env GOFIPS140=$snap
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw

go list -f '{{.Root}}' crypto/internal/fips140/$snap/aes
stdout 'fips140'

go test crypto/internal/fips140/$snap/aes
stdout '^ok\s+crypto/internal/fips140/'$snap'/aes\s+[0-9.]+s'
go test crypto/internal/fips140/$snap/aes
stdout '^ok\s+crypto/internal/fips140/'$snap'/aes\s+\(cached\)'
